:::{#def-inflection-point}
#### Inflection point

An **inflection point** of a [function](functions.qmd#def-function) $f$ is a point $c$
such that, on some open interval around $c$,
the [second derivative](calculus-derivatives.qmd#def-second-derivative) $f''$ is positive on one side of $c$ and negative on the other.
At an inflection point, the [graph](functions.qmd#def-graph) changes between curving up and curving down.

:::
